acceptance.text: Create a versioned ignored archive with minimum raw/prepared data, executable source snapshot, provenance, checksums, coverage and scientific/sharing limitations.

acceptance.text: Verify safe extraction and every payload checksum in a fresh directory, then validate and reproduce all derived products offline without hidden local dependencies.
acceptance.evidence: Safely extracted to /private/tmp/soil-climate-package-test.UeroHE/extracted and verified all 2,618 payload hashes. Isolated Python with OFFLINE=1 and socket audit hooks validated all 100 raw requests, registry and geometry roles. A separate root with no derived inputs regenerated all 2,387 derived files byte-for-byte; all 222 raw/source/input files and original extracted payload remained unchanged. No hidden project dependency was found.
